fullPassage: Economists like teaching about taxes and subsidies because they don't "stick" where they "land". Some of a tax's burden or a subsidy's benefit passes from those who write or cash the check to other market participants because taxes and subsidies change people's behavior. Buyers might bear the brunt of a tax legally paid by sellers and vice versa. Who is legally responsible for writing the check doesn't matter. How suppliers and demanders respond to changing prices does. Cigarette buyers tend to be less price-sensitive than sellers. When large tobacco companies get taxed, the cigarette supply shrinks. Smokers pay higher prices, but most don't cut back much because they aren't especially price-sensitive. Cigarette taxes land on huge corporations with a great amount of cash but stick to disproportionately poor smokers.

Taxes don't "stick" where they "(A)[land / disappear]". Some of a tax's (B)[burden / benefit] passes from sellers to buyers. Cigarette taxes land on corporations but stick to (C)[poor / rich] smokers.

det.korean: 세금은 '떨어지는(land)' 곳에 '붙어있지(stick)' 않는다. 세금의 부담(burden)은 이동한다. 결국 '가난한(poor)' 흡연자에게 붙는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① land - burden - poor: 원문 흐름과 일치
❌ ② benefit: 세금의 'burden'이지 'benefit'이 아님
❌ ③ disappear: 원문은 'land'
❌ ④ rich: 가난한 흡연자에게 붙는다는 것이 핵심
det.tip: land(떨어지다) ≠ stick(붙다). 세금 귀착(tax incidence)의 핵심 개념.

det.tip: get + p.p. = 수동의 의미. get taxed = be taxed

questions.passage: Economists like teaching about taxes and subsidies because they don't "stick" where they "land". Some of a tax's burden or a subsidy's benefit passes from those who write or cash the check to other market participants because taxes and subsidies change people's behavior. Buyers might bear the brunt of a tax legally paid by sellers and vice versa. Who is legally responsible for writing the check doesn't matter. How suppliers and demanders respond to changing prices does. Cigarette buyers tend to be less price-sensitive than sellers. When large tobacco companies get taxed, the cigarette supply shrinks. Smokers pay higher prices, but most don't cut back much because they aren't especially price-sensitive. Cigarette taxes land on huge corporations with a great amount of cash but stick to disproportionately poor smokers.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 어휘 중 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?

Economists like teaching about taxes and subsidies because they don't "stick" where they ① "land". Some of a tax's burden ② passes from those who ③ write or cash the check to ④ fewer market participants.

det.korean: 원문은 'other market participants(다른 시장 참여자들)'이다. fewer(더 적은)는 의미 변형.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ fewer → 원문은 other. 세금은 다른 참여자들에게 이전됨
❌ ① land: 떨어지다/부과되다 — 적절
❌ ② passes: 이전된다 — 적절
❌ ③ write: 수표를 쓰다 — 적절
det.tip: other market participants = 다른 시장 참여자들. fewer는 수량 변형.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 'vice versa'와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

Buyers might bear the brunt of a tax legally paid by sellers and vice versa.

det.korean: vice versa = 반대로도, 역도 마찬가지. the other way around(반대로도).
det.analysis:
✅ ① the other way around: 반대로도 — vice versa의 정확한 의미
❌ ② in the same way: 같은 방식으로 — 반대
❌ ③ without exception: 예외 없이 — 관련 없음
❌ ④ for this reason: 이런 이유로 — 관련 없음
det.tip: vice versa = conversely = the other way around = 반대로도

questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Cigarette taxes land on huge corporations with a great amount of cash but stick to ______ poor smokers.

det.korean: 'disproportionately poor smokers' — 불균형적으로 가난한 흡연자에게 귀착됨. 대기업에 부과되지만 빈곤층이 실질 부담.
det.analysis:
✅ ① disproportionately: 불균형적으로 — 원문 표현. 불균형적 귀착
❌ ② occasionally: 가끔 — 빈도 부사, 의미 다름
❌ ③ proportionately: 비례해서 — 반대 의미
❌ ④ moderately: 적당히 — 의미 다름
det.tip: disproportionate = not proportional = 불균형적인. 세금이 가난한 계층에 불균형적으로 귀착.
